newsitem.title: HONG KONG: QPL International mandates $100 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: QPL International mandates $100 mln FRN.

text.p: QPL International Holdings Ltd has mandated Sumitomo Finance Asia and Standard Chartered Bank to arrange a US$100 million floating rate note issue, bankers said on Friday.
They said the issue was originally expected to be US$75 million but was increased to US$100 million due to oversubscription in the sub-underwriting stage.
The facility has a final maturity of five years with a put option in year three.
General syndication will start after the Chinese New Year holidays which begin on February 6, they said.
